page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.4-64 is a virtual compute instance built on the 64-bit Arm architecture. It is powered by 3.0 GHz Ampere AmpereOne processors configured with 8 dedicated physical cores, corresponding directly to 8 vCPUs with one thread per core. The absence of simultaneous multithreading provides predictable instruction execution without hyperthreading resource contention.

The instance is allocated 64 GB of system memory, providing an 8 GB per core ratio that matches memory-intensive operational requirements. The instance does not include integrated local storage or hardware GPU accelerators, necessitating remote block volumes for operating system disks and data persistence. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

AmpereOne Arm cores emphasize predictable execution and power efficiency. By assigning fully dedicated physical cores rather than shared virtual threads, VM.Standard.A2.Flex.4-64 maintains consistent throughput under sustained multi-threaded loads. A principal tradeoff involves software compatibility, as binaries and dependencies must support the arm64 architecture.

Given its 8-core allocation and 64 GB memory capacity, VM.Standard.A2.Flex.4-64 fits in-memory caching tiers, relational database engines, Java and Go application servers, containerized microservices, and memory-heavy compilation pipelines.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.4-64 is a flexible Arm-architecture instance tailored for workloads demanding substantial memory per core. Powered by Ampere AmpereOne processors running at 3.0 GHz, this configuration provides 8 dedicated physical cores mapped to 8 vCPUs with a single thread per core, eliminating noisy-neighbor resource competition common to simultaneous multithreading. It features 64 GB of system RAM, maintaining an expansive 8 GB per core ratio aligned with memory-optimized profiles. The server does not include integrated local NVMe storage or dedicated hardware GPU accelerators, requiring attached network block storage for persistence. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is included by default. The dedicated core model paired with Arm architecture delivers predictable execution and cost-efficient scaling for compute tasks. VM.Standard.A2.Flex.4-64 is best configured for in-memory caching layers, medium-scale relational databases, containerized microservices, CI/CD compilation, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
